Name: AnimationCancel Practice Mod
Author: theunderscore76
Description:
Some of the speedrun tech in Stardew Valley is difficult to learn and master, so this will be a set of tools to help highlight/overlay game state information to make it easier to learn.

For now, it only serves to highlight the animation cancel frames for different tools as you swing to help you learn the timing.[url=https://imgur.com/GvEStFC]

Example of the Animation Canceling overlay

[/url][url=https://github.com/Underscore76/SDVPracticeMod/releases/tag/v1.0]See the code on Github[/url]
